featured_reason: The terminal recommendation is plausible under the old policy, but the trajectory proves the policy changed and localizes four distinct failures.
limitations: Five scenarios do not represent real underwriting work or population diversity.
Scripted policies validate harness sensitivity; they do not estimate model capability.
A hash chain is tamper-evident but does not prove signer identity or truthful sensing.
No human agreement, live model panel, customer validity or training lift is measured.
